evidence_boundaries.browser: CE-12 uses real IdP/BFF/Biz API/MySQL; ordinary web/e2e tests are UI contract evidence and are not relabeled as CE-12.

evidence_boundaries.migration_recovery: Per current human directive #191 proceeds without #190. The recovery/migration no-permission-resurrection counterexample remains NOT_EVALUATED_CURRENT_DIRECTIVE and must not be relabeled PASS without independent migration/restore evidence.

result_semantics.contract_status: Coverage in this file means a required evidence path exists; it is not a runtime PASS.
result_semantics.runtime_pass: A #191 runtime PASS requires exact candidate SHA/tree, actual test execution, zero required skips, reported samples/windows, and raw evidence receipt.
result_semantics.skipped_or_missing: Missing test, zero matches, skipped required case, or absent raw evidence is BLOCKED/FAIL, never PASS.
